description: Evaluation questions for Customer Care: Store Helpdesk & POS Support

eval_cases.input: What is the average Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) for critical P1 POS hardware outages by store region?

What are the top 3 hardware categories generating store associate helpdesk tickets?
List active recurring store system bugs, their affected store counts, and current Jira engineering status.
What are the enterprise retail industry benchmarks for store helpdesk first-call resolution and POS MTTR?
